reason: Because I already gave $200 to the ambulance fund this month and remember the failed campaign, Document B's math—showing that the remaining $49,000 needed from the public is only $2,000 more than we raised last time, or about $7.50 per resident—makes me believe the goal is actually reachable and that a small pledge from me is worthwhile. Document A leaves me doing that math myself and ends with an unaddressed warning about a 15% roof cost increase that makes me worry the campaign will fall short again.
